# Reshape the data to have one row per country and year

education_expenditure_series.columns = ['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Year', 'Education Expenditure']

gdp_series = gdp_series.set_index(['Country Group', 'Country Code']).stack().reset_index()
gdp_series.columns = ['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Year', 'GNI per Capita']

# Merge the two datasets on 'Country Group', 'Country Code', and 'Year'
merged_df = pd.merge(education_expenditure_series, gdp_series, on=['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Year'])

lower_middle_income = merged_df[merged_df['Country Group'] == 'Lower middle income']

# Perform linear regression for Sub-Saharan Africa
X_sub = sm.add_constant(sub_saharan_africa['Education Expenditure'])
y_sub = sub_saharan_africa['GNI per Capita']
model_sub = sm.OLS(y_sub, X_sub).fit()
coeff_sub = model_sub.params[1]
p_value_sub = model_sub.pvalues[1]

# Perform linear regression for Lower Middle Income countries
X_lmc = sm.add_constant(lower_middle_income['Education Expenditure'])
y_lmc = lower_middle_income['GNI per Capita']
